name: Shimokita Hideki
source:
A naive, young man who left his hometown to enroll in a university. 

Has a meek personality and is inexperienced when it comes to women, but with the guidance of Yumi, he slowly changes. 

Is a virgin, but contrary to his looks, his sexual desire is exceedingly huge, enough to trouble Yumi who is confident with her stamina. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ239450.html]DLsite[/url]]
